verdicts.reason: A shrinks the logo until the sun icon is a single dot and the SOLSTICE wordmark can't be read, and it leaves a huge empty dark panel. Its orange divider also runs through the word 'Yet' in the headline, and the headline is jammed against the left edge of the cream panel. B keeps the sun and wordmark legible and puts the divider properly under the headline, giving a clean centred stack. B's copy column is still tight with little vertical space between elements, and the legal text is tiny, so it needs polish before shipping.
